verses.english: There is a thing that’s unpleasant to do,
There is a thing that’s unpleasant to do,
There is a thing that’s pleasant to do,
There is a thing that’s pleasant to do,

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṁ ṭhānaṁ amanāpaṁ kātuṁ;
verses.english: Take the thing that’s unpleasant to do,

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṁ ubhayeneva na kattabbaṁ maññati.
verses.english: This is regarded as a thing that shouldn’t be done on both grounds:
and because doing it proves harmful.

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṁ ubhayeneva na kattabbaṁ maññati.
verses.english: This is regarded as a thing that shouldn’t be done on both grounds.

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṁ ṭhānaṁ amanāpaṁ kātuṁ;
verses.english: Next, take the thing that’s unpleasant to do,

verses.pali: imasmiṁ, bhikkhave, ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisathāme purisavīriye purisaparakkame.
verses.english: It is here that you can tell who is foolish and who is astute in regard to human strength, energy, and vigor.
‘Despite the fact that this thing is unpleasant to do,

verses.pali: atha carahidaṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattatī’ti.
Tassa taṁ ṭhānaṁ akayiramānaṁ anatthāya saṁvattati.
Paṇḍito ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:

verses.english: ‘Even though this thing is unpleasant to do,

verses.pali: atha carahidaṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattatī’ti.
Tassa taṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattati.
Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṁ ṭhānaṁ manāpaṁ kātuṁ;
verses.english: Next, take the thing that’s pleasant to do,

verses.pali: imasmimpi, bhikkhave, ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisathāme purisavīriye purisaparakkame.
verses.english: It is here that you can tell who is foolish and who is astute in regard to human strength, energy, and vigor.
‘Even though this thing is pleasant to do,

verses.pali: atha carahidaṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ anatthāya saṁvattatī’ti.
Tassa taṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ anatthāya saṁvattati.
Paṇḍito ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:

verses.english: ‘Despite the fact that this thing is pleasant to do,

verses.pali: atha carahidaṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ anatthāya saṁvattatī’ti.
Tassa taṁ ṭhānaṁ akayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattati.
Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṁ ṭhānaṁ manāpaṁ kātuṁ, tañca kayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattati—
verses.english: Next, take the thing that’s pleasant to do, and doing it proves beneficial.

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṁ ubhayeneva kattabbaṁ maññati.
verses.english: This is regarded as a thing that should be done on both grounds:

verses.pali: Yampidaṁ ṭhānaṁ manāpaṁ kātuṁ, imināpi naṁ kattabbaṁ maññati;
yampidaṁ ṭhānaṁ kayiramānaṁ atthāya saṁvattati, imināpi naṁ kattabbaṁ maññati.
verses.english: and because doing it proves beneficial.

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṁ ubhayeneva kattabbaṁ maññati.
verses.english: This is regarded as a thing that should be done on both grounds.
